kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/main.tf --
data "archive_file" "this" {
  type        = "zip"
  source_dir  = "${path.module}/src"
  output_path = "${path.module}/build/package.zip"
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "this" {
  function_name = "f"
  role          = "r"
  filename      = data.archive_file.this.output_path
  timeout       = 3
}
-- base/src/index.py --
print(1)

  type        = "zip"

  output_path = "${path.module}/build/package.zip"
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "this" {
  function_name = "f"

}

print(1)
